title: Preventing autoimmunity after alemtuzumab in multiple sclerosis: regulatory T cells resist expansion
title_zh: 预防艾伦单抗后的自身免疫：调节性T细胞抵抗扩增
abstract: This scientific commentary refers to ‘Low-dose IL-2 fails to expand Tregs after alemtuzumab: insight into impaired immune tolerance in multiple sclerosis’, by Georgieva et al. (https://doi.org/10.1093/brain/awag171).
abstract_zh: 本科学性评论引用了Georgieva等人（https://doi.org/10.1093/brain/awag171）的研究：‘艾伦单抗后低剂量白细胞介素-2未能扩增Tregs：关于多发性硬化症中受损免疫耐受的见解’。
